mapper.select:
SELECT a.STCD,a.STNM,a.HNNM,a.BSNM, b.ZTM TM,b.ZSTCD ADMAUTH,b.SOURCE,b.UPZ,b.DWZ,b.TYPE, a.GTOPNUM,a.OMCNUM,a.SFQ,b.ZD, case when a.LGTD is null then 0 else cast( a.LGTD as float) end as LGTD, case when a.LTTD is null then 0 else cast( a.LTTD as float) end as LTTD FROM ( SELECT ST_STBPRP_B.*,st_rvfcch_b.GRQ GTOPNUM,st_rvfcch_b.FLPQ OMCNUM,st_rvfcch_b.SFQ FROM ST_STBPRP_B LEFT JOIN st_rvfcch_b on ST_STBPRP_B.STCD = st_rvfcch_b.STCD ) a INNER JOIN st_stbprp_b_stcd b on a.STCD = b.STCD
ISSTATUS='1' AND b.TYPE='1'
and a.STCD in
#{stcd}
ORDER BY TM DESC
